Added: Files larger than 512KB now show an opt-in placeholder instead of rendering automatically, keeping the app responsive on big documents
Fixed: Typing and scrolling no longer stall while a large file's preview is (re)parsing, by deferring the render until the browser can catch up
Preview no longer fully reparses on every unrelated app re-render

Added: Preview-only view mode — the toggle now cycles through Markdown, Preview, and Split instead of just Edit/Split
Segmented toggle control with distinct icons and labels for each view mode
Changed: Preview content now renders at a constrained, readable width instead of stretching full-width
Preview now uses the host's dedicated reading-mode prose classes when available, falling back to the editor's prose classes on older hosts

Added: Split view mode — the preview button now toggles a live preview panel alongside the markdown source instead of opening a separate read-only tab; pressing the button again returns to editor-only mode
Fixed: Preview no longer flickers when switching between documents

title: Initial Release
description: Live markdown preview panel for Voiden documents.

Added: Live markdown rendering in a split panel
